name: Media Maratón de Mérida

trackSource.notes: The official course page links a public Google My Maps map titled "Circuito Homologado Media Maratón Mérida 2027" (this edition), plus a KMZ "Circuito Homologado Media Maratón Mérida 2026" and a 2026 Wikiloc trail. The 2027 map exported as KML on 2026-11-27 measures 21.195 km (+0.46%); the 2026 KMZ measures 21.331 km (+1.11%). Both differ from the route in data/ (from the 2024 Wikiloc track, 21.097 km) and the existing points do not fit them, so the 2027 route was not imported.

notes: On 2026-11-27 the 2027 date, start time and the 2027 course map were published; the route in data/es/media-maraton-merida/2027 is still the carried-over 2024 Wikiloc track, pending a person rebuilding the points for the 2027 course.
